name: Antica Gelateria del Corso
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Antica Gelateria del Corso in Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest **Gelato** and **Eis** in the heart of the Alps. Our authentic Italian gelato, crafted with love and passion, brings a taste of Italy to the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

From creamy **Vanille** to rich **Schokolade**, our selection of flavors will delight your taste buds. Enjoy your gelato while taking in the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains or relax in our cozy seating area.

Visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, or **Lienz**—where every scoop is a moment of pure joy!

**Buon appetito!** 🍦
beschreibung: The Antica Gelateria del Corso in **Kufstein** is a beloved ice cream café that delights with an irresistible selection of creamy ice cream specialties and refreshing desserts. Guests enjoy a cool respite on sunny days or after a hike in the mountains, all in a relaxed atmosphere. The menu features classic flavors like vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry, as well as unique creations and seasonal surprises. Pair your treat with fine coffee specialties, fruity milkshakes, or seductive ice cream sundaes that leave nothing to be desired. Whether you're taking a quick break, sharing an ice cream sundae with family, or enjoying a romantic date with an affogato, Antica Gelateria del Corso is **Kufstein**’s sweet spot that captivates both young and old.
